name: Monteggia Fracture-Dislocation
definition: Fracture of the proximal ulna with dislocation of the radial head, requiring recognition of both components to restore forearm and elbow alignment.

investigations.principle: Forearm radiographs must include elbow and wrist; CT is selective for complex injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Most adult Monteggia injuries require operative fixation and radial-head reduction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna-Sandhi displacement phenotype may be documented only after orthopedic stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the proximal ulna with dislocation of the radial head, requiring recognition of both components to restore forearm and elbow alignment.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
